name: The Sunken City
description: The ruins of an ancient city, now submerged beneath the waves. The water is surprisingly clear, allowing you to see the crumbling architecture and strange, bioluminescent sea life.

surface.description: You are on a small, rocky island in the middle of a vast ocean. A set of ancient stone steps leads down into the water to the east.

city_gates.description: You've descended into the Sunken City. The massive, coral-encrusted gates of the city stand before you. The way back to the surface is to the west. The city proper lies to the north.

plaza.description: You are in a grand plaza. Crumbling statues of forgotten kings are scattered around a central fountain. Streets lead west, east, and south.

library.description: You are in what was once a grand library. Stone tablets and scrolls are scattered across the floor, covered in a thin layer of silt. The only exit is east, back to the plaza.

palace.description: You are in the ruins of a magnificent palace. A grand staircase leads up to a shattered throne. The only exit is west, back to the plaza.

secrets_of_the_deep.name: Secrets of the Deep
secrets_of_the_deep.description: Uncover the history of the Sunken City.
steps: Find the ancient tablet in the library.
